_source: One plot per crop. Prices and seconds are GUESSES (docs/FACTORY.md); prices are v0.6a's × the value change of the sauce that pays for the plot (D035). `unlocked` plots need no blueprint: Bell, Poblano and Jalapeño are on sale from the start, priced on Idle Planet Miner's opening ladder (Poblano $520, Jalapeño $1,700, ×3.3) to pay back from raw sales in 5–10 minutes (D041, D048). Chocolate Habanero (was Red Savina) and Moruga Scorpion were lowered in D041 ($2.6M to $2.0M, $9.5M to $5M). `name` is the station's name on screen, by default <crop> Plot; made ingredients get their own (D024).
